**Written to `HANDOFF.md`.**

Roll back `dep-4471`, the gateway config deploy by a.novak. It set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`. Each request then held a connection for its whole life. The pool holds 20. It filled and never drained. Apply the rollback to all three gateway nodes.

Broken from 02:14:18 to 03:59:27 UTC. That is 1 hour 45 minutes, still going.

One thing I had missed before. `/health` returned 200 the entire time. It never takes a pool connection. So the load balancer never pulled this node out.
